correctness.rationale: Write missing count as size of intersection of independent uniform complements m_i=n-s_i. For an elementary pair balancing (a,b)->(a+1,b-1), hypergeometric mass ratio p_new(j)/p_old(j) is proportional to (b-j)/(a+1-j), nondecreasing in j, including the extra largest endpoint; this establishes pairwise likelihood-ratio and first-order stochastic dominance. Conditional on size, intersection is uniform among subsets: a common random permutation yields nested uniform intersections J<=Jprime. Intersect with the remaining independent complements and iterate balancing transfers to prove whole-array dominance for all n,k and all integer thresholds. E U = n product_i (1-s_i/n) and the positive balancing increment establishes interior strict expected order; boundary cases with zeros or whole-population packets are allowed in the weak stochastic result. Independent exact rational enumeration checked hypergeometric tails up to n14 and 3-packet distributions up to n6, not an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Betken–Thale 2022/2023 and Stadje 1990 study uniform group drawings with the same packet cardinality in every round. Schilling 2021 and Berend–Sher 2026 vary probabilities of drawing different subsets of one fixed cardinality, not deterministic unequal packet sizes across rounds. Their fixed-size/selection-probability statements do not imply the full all-round majorization stochastic order. Classical hypergeometric likelihood ratios and majorization transfers are acknowledged mathematical tools; an overlooked broader sampling-without-replacement stochastic-order theorem remains possible.
residual_risks: A general hypergeometric intersection stochastic-order theorem under majorization might subsume this proof despite absence of a located exact coupon paper.
Older Stadje (1990) and Schilling (2021) whole primary texts were not available; only accessible summaries/model statements compared.
Packet draws must be independent, uniform without replacement within packets, and have fixed deterministic sizes; interior strictness excludes zero complement sizes.

value.rationale: At a fixed coupon-exposure budget, exact dominance for every missing-count tail answers a genuine packet-allocation optimization question, stronger than mean comparison or asymptotics. The uniform pairwise coupling and all-round transfer yield sharp simultaneous optimal profiles, rather than recomputing a known fixed-size collector waiting time.

final_claim: For independent uniformly random s_i-subsets of an n-coupon set, fixed total exposures and integer packet-size vector s majorizing t (more uneven), the total unseen-coupon count satisfies U_s <=_st U_t. Under interior packet bounds the most balanced vector maximizes U and the most concentrated minimizes it, with uniqueness of the expected-missing extrema up to permutation.
